# MASTER'S RESEARCH — LIVER VIABILITY & ICG-NIR {#masters-research}

My Master's thesis develops an **ex vivo rat liver perfusion model** for biomedical instrumentation,
physiological monitoring and functional assessment. The current public portfolio focuses on the experimental
platform and baseline work that can already be shown.

**Experimental model:** isolated perfused rat liver (*ex vivo*).

The research is organized in three objectives. Objectives 1 and 2 describe the current experimental platform
and baseline characterization. Objective 3, focused on ICG-NIR, is still in progress.

## Objective 1 — Ex Vivo Perfusion Platform {#objective-1}

Build and validate a stable and reproducible platform for **ex vivo rat liver perfusion** under controlled
experimental conditions.

### Perfusion circuit

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["Reservoir"] --> B["Peristaltic Pump"]
    B --> C["Pulse Damper"]
    C --> D["Flow Sensor"]
    D --> E["Oxygenator"]
    E --> F["Bubble Trap"]
    F --> G["Rat Liver"]
    G --> H["Return"]
```

The current rat-liver platform uses software monitoring for the experimental variables. The portfolio shows

### Calibration and validation

The measurement chain was calibrated and checked against **certified reference instrumentation / standards**.
Validation used quantitative comparisons including **correlation, deviation and RMSE**. No additional
calibration photographs are included in the public portfolio.

## Objective 2 — Baseline Dataset without ICG {#objective-2}

This objective characterizes the stability of the **ex vivo rat liver model** before introducing ICG.
The baseline is based on physiological and hydrodynamic variables such as pressure, flow, temperature,
vascular resistance and perfusate state.

At this stage, the portfolio intentionally emphasizes the experimental platform and acquisition system rather
than presenting additional figures that are not yet part of the selected public material.

## Objective 3 — ICG-NIR Functional Marker {#objective-3}

**Coming soon — this objective is currently in progress.**

# ROBOTICS & REHABILITATION {#robotics-rehabilitation}

## Ciervo UC — CYBATHLON 2024 {#cybathlon}

I participated in CYBATHLON 2024 in Zürich as **Electrical Area Leader** of Ciervo UC, contributing to the
electrical and electromechanical integration of a robotic transfemoral prosthesis for competition.

### My role

- Electronic and electromechanical integration.
- Coordination between electronics, control and mechanics.
- Troubleshooting during prototype and competition preparation.
- Testing under real-world constraints with the pilot.

## CandelStim — Transcranial Electrical Stimulation {#candelstim}

Professional internship at Candel Medical Company involving electronics, firmware and verification work for
a transcranial electrical stimulation platform.

**Confidentiality:** this project is covered by an active NDA. Public information is intentionally limited to
high-level responsibilities and artifacts prepared specifically for safe disclosure. No confidential circuit,
firmware, protocol or product-design details are included here.

The material shown publicly is limited to:

- a DDS calibration result;
- a deliberately pixelated circuit photograph;
- the software created for connection and therapy-protocol verification.

## FPGA Upgrade — Universal Testing Machine {#fpga}

Development of an FPGA-based processing board for a universal mechanical testing machine.

The system processes signals associated with **force, displacement, deformation and speed** using
**Zybo Z10, Vivado and VHDL**.
